In a little part of New York called Greenwich Village, the streets run crazily and cross each other in strange ways. <break time="0.8s" /> Artists soon came to live there because the rooms were old and cheap. <break time="0.8s" /> At the top of a short brick building, Sue and Johnsy had their studio. <break time="0.8s" /> They had met in May at a cheap restaurant and found that their tastes in art were the same. <break time="0.8s" /> So they decided to share a studio. <break time="0.8s" /> In November a cold, unseen stranger, whom the doctors called Pneumonia, walked through the Village. <break time="0.8s" /> He touched one person here and another there with his icy fingers. <break time="0.8s" /> One of the people he touched was Johnsy. <break time="0.8s" /> She lay in her bed, hardly moving, and looked through the window at the brick wall of the next house.

뉴욕의 작은 지역에서는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리니치빌리지라고 불리는. <break time="0.8s" /> 길들이 제멋대로 뻗어 있다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 서로 엇갈린다. <break time="0.8s" /> 이상한 방식으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 곧 화가들이 그곳에 살러 왔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 방들이 낡고 쌌기 때문에. <break time="0.8s" /> 나지막한 벽돌 건물의 꼭대기에. <break time="0.8s" /> 수와 존시는 작업실을 가지고 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그들은 5월에 만났었다 싼 식당에서. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 알게 되었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 미술에 대한 취향이 같다는 것을. <break time="0.8s" /> 그래서 그들은 결정했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 작업실을 함께 쓰기로. <break time="0.8s" /> 11월에. <break time="0.8s" /> 차갑고 눈에 보이지 않는 낯선 이가. <break time="0.8s" /> 의사들이 폐렴이라고 부르는. <break time="0.8s" /> 마을을 걸어 다녔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그는 여기서 한 사람을 건드렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 저기서 또 한 사람을. <break time="0.8s" /> 얼음 같은 손가락으로. <break time="0.8s" /> 사람들 중 하나는. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 건드린. <break time="0.8s" /> 존시였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 침대에 누워 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 거의 움직이지 않은 채. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 창문 너머로 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 옆집의 벽돌담을.

One morning. <break time="0.8s" /> The busy doctor called Sue. <break time="0.8s" /> Into the hall. <break time="0.8s" /> She has one chance in ten. <break time="0.8s" /> He said. <break time="0.8s" /> And that chance is for her to want to live. <break time="0.8s" /> She has made up her mind. <break time="0.8s" /> That she is not going to get well. <break time="0.8s" /> After the doctor left. <break time="0.8s" /> Sue went into Johnsys room. <break time="0.8s" /> With her drawing board. <break time="0.8s" /> Whistling a cheerful tune. <break time="0.8s" /> Johnsy was lying. <break time="0.8s" /> With her eyes wide open. <break time="0.8s" /> Counting backward. <break time="0.8s" /> Twelve, she said. <break time="0.8s" /> And a little later, eleven. <break time="0.8s" /> And then ten and nine. <break time="0.8s" /> Sue looked out of the window. <break time="0.8s" /> And saw only an old ivy vine. <break time="0.8s" /> Climbing up the brick wall. <break time="0.8s" /> Leaves on the ivy. <break time="0.8s" /> Johnsy whispered. <break time="0.8s" /> When the last one falls. <break time="0.8s" /> I must go too. <break time="0.8s" /> I have known that for three days. <break time="0.8s" /> Oh, I never heard of such nonsense. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Sue. <break time="0.8s" /> But Johnsy only closed her eyes.

어느 날 아침. <break time="0.8s" /> 바쁜 의사가 수를 불렀다. <break time="0.8s" /> 복도로. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀에게는 열에 한 번의 가능성이 있다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 그 가능성은 그녀가 살고 싶어 하는 것이다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그녀는 마음을 정해 버렸다. <break time="0.8s" /> 자기가 낫지 않을 거라고. <break time="0.8s" /> 의사가 떠난 뒤. <break time="0.8s" /> 수는 존시의 방으로 들어갔다. <break time="0.8s" /> 화판을 들고. <break time="0.8s" /> 명랑한 곡조로 휘파람을 불며. <break time="0.8s" /> 존시는 누워 있었다. <break time="0.8s" /> 눈을 크게 뜬 채. <break time="0.8s" /> 거꾸로 숫자를 세면서. <break time="0.8s" /> 열둘 그녀가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 조금 뒤 열하나. <break time="0.8s" /> 그다음엔 열, 아홉. <break time="0.8s" /> 수는 창밖을 내다보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 그리고 오래된 담쟁이덩굴 하나만 보았다. <break time="0.8s" /> 벽돌담을 타고 올라가는. <break time="0.8s" /> 담쟁이에 붙은 잎. <break time="0.8s" /> 존시가 속삭였다. <break time="0.8s" /> 마지막 잎이 떨어지면. <break time="0.8s" /> 나도 가야 해. <break time="0.8s" /> 나는 그걸 알고 있었어 사흘 동안. <break time="0.8s" /> 어머, 그런 터무니없는 소리는 들어 본 적 없어. <break time="0.8s" /> 수가 말했다. <break time="0.8s" /> 하지만 존시는 그저 눈을 감았다.

Old Behrman was a painter. <break time="0.8s" /> Who lived on the ground floor. <break time="0.8s" /> Below them. <break time="0.8s" /> He was past sixty. <break time="0.8s" /> And had a long gray beard. <break time="0.8s" /> For forty years. <break time="0.8s" /> He had painted. <break time="0.8s" /> But he had never been successful. <break time="0.8s" /> He was always about to paint. <break time="0.8s" /> A masterpiece but he had never yet begun it. <break time="0.8s" /> He drank too much. <break time="0.8s" /> And laughed at softness. <break time="0.8s" /> In anyone. <break time="0.8s" /> Yet he thought of himself. <break time="0.8s" /> As a guard. <break time="0.8s" /> To protect the two young artists upstairs. <break time="0.8s" /> When Sue told him. <break time="0.8s" /> About Johnsys idea. <break time="0.8s" /> He shouted angrily. <break time="0.8s" /> At such foolishness. <break time="0.8s" /> That night. <break time="0.8s" /> A cold rain fell. <break time="0.8s" /> Mixed with snow. <break time="0.8s" /> And a fierce wind. <break time="0.8s" /> Blew all night long. <break time="0.8s" /> Sue was sure. <break time="0.8s" /> That the last leaf would be gone. <break time="0.8s" /> By morning.

In the morning Johnsy told Sue. <break time="0.8s" /> To pull up the shade. <break time="0.8s" /> After the beating rain. <break time="0.8s" /> And fierce wind. <break time="0.8s" /> One ivy leaf. <break time="0.8s" /> Still hung against the brick wall. <break time="0.8s" /> It was dark green. <break time="0.8s" /> Near the stem. <break time="0.8s" /> And yellow at the edges. <break time="0.8s" /> The leaf stayed there all day. <break time="0.8s" /> And it was still there. <break time="0.8s" /> Through the second stormy night. <break time="0.8s" /> I have been a bad girl, Sudie. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Johnsy. <break time="0.8s" /> Something has made that last leaf. <break time="0.8s" /> Stay there. <break time="0.8s" /> To show me. <break time="0.8s" /> How wicked I was. <break time="0.8s" /> It is wrong. <break time="0.8s" /> To want to die. <break time="0.8s" /> She said. <break time="0.8s" /> And she asked for some soup. <break time="0.8s" /> The next day. <break time="0.8s" /> The doctor said. <break time="0.8s" /> She is out of danger. <break time="0.8s" /> And you have won. <break time="0.8s" /> But there is sad news, too. <break time="0.8s" /> He added. <break time="0.8s" /> Old Behrman has pneumonia. <break time="0.8s" /> And there is no hope for him.

Old Behrman died. <break time="0.8s" /> In the hospital. <break time="0.8s" /> Two days later. <break time="0.8s" /> That afternoon. <break time="0.8s" /> Sue came to the bed. <break time="0.8s" /> Where Johnsy lay. <break time="0.8s" /> And put her arm around her. <break time="0.8s" /> I have something. <break time="0.8s" /> To tell you. <break time="0.8s" /> She said. <break time="0.8s" /> On the first stormy night. <break time="0.8s" /> The janitor found Mister Behrman. <break time="0.8s" /> In his room. <break time="0.8s" /> Helpless with pain. <break time="0.8s" /> His shoes and clothes. <break time="0.8s" /> Were wet through and icy cold. <break time="0.8s" /> They could not imagine. <break time="0.8s" /> Where he had been on such a terrible night. <break time="0.8s" /> Then they found a lantern. <break time="0.8s" /> Still lit. <break time="0.8s" /> And a ladder. <break time="0.8s" /> That had been dragged from its place. <break time="0.8s" /> There were also some brushes. <break time="0.8s" /> And a palette. <break time="0.8s" /> With green and yellow colors. <break time="0.8s" /> Mixed on it. <break time="0.8s" /> Look out of the window, dear. <break time="0.8s" /> At the last ivy leaf. <break time="0.8s" /> On the wall. <break time="0.8s" /> Did you not wonder. <break time="0.8s" /> Why it never moved. <break time="0.8s" /> When the wind blew. <break time="0.8s" /> Ah, darling. <break time="0.8s" /> It is Behrmans masterpiece. <break time="0.8s" /> He painted it there. <break time="0.8s" /> The night the last leaf fell.
